```{haskell}
--| label: fig-player
--| fig-cap: "The same example in Haskell:"
data Player = Player { x :: Float, y :: Float, dx :: Float, dy :: Float }

update :: Player -> Player
update player = player { x = x player + dx player, y = y player + dy player }
```
